title: A Web-based Adaptive and Intelligent Tutor by Expert Systems
extended_summary:
This paper proposes a web-based adaptive and intelligent tutoring system built around expert systems, with the goal of making e-learning more dynamic, customized, and efficient. The authors argue that static, one-size-fits-all web instruction is inadequate for diverse learners, and they present an architecture intended to adjust content, pacing, and presentation style to learner characteristics and learning style.

The proposed approach combines learner profiling, a pre-test, adaptive delivery of learning concepts, and a post-test. The system uses a questionnaire to infer learner type, then selects content and teaching methods from a knowledge base and updates the learner model as the learner progresses. The paper frames this as an intelligent tutoring system for web-based learning, with supporting features such as remote access, virtual class functionality, and feedback-driven adaptation.

The paper discusses intended use for learners in intelligent schools and more broadly for remote web-based education, but it does not report an empirical study with participants, comparison groups, or measured learning outcomes. Its main contribution is a conceptual system design and justification for adaptive expert-system-based tutoring, along with examples of related intelligent tutoring systems and a proposed workflow for implementation.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a conceptual/prototype paper describing a proposed system rather than reporting a controlled empirical evaluation. It does not present a study design, comparison group, or analyzed outcome data.
impact_tier_rationale: No measurable educational impact is reported. The paper makes qualitative claims about improved efficiency and lower cost, but provides no effect sizes or outcome evidence.

interventions.use_case: web-based adaptive intelligent tutoring that models learner style/knowledge, delivers a pre-test, personalized concept instruction, and a post-test using an expert system and learner model
personalized web-based learning platform that adapts content sequence, pace, and presentation style to learner characteristics and learning style
web-delivered instructional software with quizzes, multimedia, FAQs, and remote access for individualized study
